requirements.label: GCSE / National 5
requirements.value: A-level applicants need GCSE Biology and Chemistry at grade 7. SQA applicants need National 5 Biology and Chemistry at grade A. English and Mathematics are required at GCSE grade 6 or National 5 grade B if not studied at A-level or Higher.

requirements.label: A-level
requirements.value: AAA including Chemistry or Biology plus another science. Mathematics is accepted as a science. General Studies is not accepted.

requirements.label: A-level contextual / widening access
requirements.value: ABB for eligible widening access applicants, with the same Chemistry/Biology plus science subject structure.

requirements.label: Scottish Highers
requirements.value: AAAAB including Chemistry or Biology plus another science. Mathematics is accepted as a science. Highers must be achieved in one sitting.

requirements.label: Scottish widening access
requirements.value: AAABB for eligible widening access applicants.

requirements.label: Advanced Higher / S6
requirements.value: BB at Advanced Higher for S6 candidates.

requirements.label: International Baccalaureate
requirements.value: 37 points overall with 6,6,6 at Higher Level, including Chemistry or Biology and another science at Higher Level.

requirements.label: UCAT
requirements.value: UCAT is required. Dundee states there is no minimum UCAT cut-off score.

requirements.label: SJT
requirements.value: SJT bands are not used as part of the initial selection for interview process.

requirements.label: Contextual criteria
requirements.value: Contextual criteria include SIMD Quintile 1, free school meals, carer status, care-experienced status, estrangement/refugee/asylum/humanitarian protection circumstances, and recognised widening access programmes such as Reach, ACES or SWAP.
